base_directory.description: Root directory where EDS stores user data files, calendars, and addressbooks.

runtime_directory.description: Directory for runtime files such as sockets, PID files, and locks.

bind_address.description: IP address to bind CalDAV/CardDAV services to (empty = all interfaces).

caldav_port.description: TCP port for CalDAV service (default 8009). Set to 0 to disable.

carddav_port.description: TCP port for CardDAV service (default 8008). Set to 0 to disable.

enable_mail.description: Enable the mail (IMAP/SMTP) backend (may require separate mail backend config).

backends.description: List of remote backends (e.g., IMAP, LDAP, WebDAV) for data sources.

password.description: Password for authentication (optional; not recommended for plaintext config — use secrets manager in production).

starttls.description: Upgrade connection using STARTTLS (for non-SSL ports).

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections allowed.

max_cached_connections.description: Maximum number of idle backend connections to keep in cache.

query_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for backend queries before aborting.

log_file.description: Path to log file (set to empty string for syslog/stdout).

require_ssl.description: Require SSL/TLS for all remote client connections.

ssl_cert_file.description: Path to SSL certificate file (PEM format).

ssl_key_file.description: Path to SSL private key file (PEM format).

ssl_ca_file.description: Path to CA certificate bundle for client verification (optional).
